card.name: Selo Temporal
card.summary: O oponente pula a próxima Fase de Compra dele.

textEvidence.text: On resolution the opponent skips their next Draw Phase. Two copies applying before that phase both cover the same phase, so the following turn draws normally. The skip concerns only regular turn draws. No deck-out check occurs for a skipped draw, Standby still happens, and unrelated effects can draw. Negation applies no future restriction. No cost or target. State persists across turns and restores.

card.name: Ganância Descuidada
card.summary: Compre duas cartas e pule suas próximas duas Fases de Compra.

textEvidence.text: On resolution draw two cards, then skip your own next two Draw Phases. Requires two cards in your Deck to activate. Multiple activations in one turn draw twice for each successful effect but the same next two phases are skipped. The skip concerns only regular turn draws. No deck-out check occurs for a skipped draw, Standby still happens, and unrelated effects can draw. Negation applies no future restriction. No cost or target. State persists across turns and restores.
